# Vencord-7TV

### The plugin is generated by Claude and is for funsies. If it breaks, womp womp.

## Install process (terrible)

```bash
git clone https://github.com/Vendicated/Vencord
cd Vencord
pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
mkdir -p src/userplugins
git clone https://github.com/bakjedev/Vencord-7TV src/userplugins/sevenTVEmotes
pnpm build
pnpm inject
```

Then restart Discord.

### Updating
`git pull` in both the `Vencord` folder and `src/userplugins/sevenTVEmotes`, then `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile`, `pnpm build`, and restart Discord.
